Title: Arrival
Walk_Bus: Uber from HNL with luggage. Skip TheBus with bags. Late check-in ~10:10 PM — rest only.
Rideshare: About $30 to $40 from HNL to Waikiki Malia.
Places: Honolulu International Airport; Waikiki Malia by Outrigger

Title: Diamond Head and Kapahulu
Walk_Bus: Book State Parks sunrise slot (~6:53 AM sunrise). Walk or TheBus 2 / 2L toward Diamond Head Rd. After the hike: Kapahulu for Leonard's and a plate lunch. Evening free sunset on Kapiolani / Queen's Surf shoreline — be on the sand by 5:30 PM (sunset ~5:48). Skip tourist trolley.
Rideshare: Rideshare to Diamond Head if you miss the early bus, about $12 to $18 each way.
Places: Diamond Head State Monument; Leonard's Bakery; Rainbow Drive-In; Kapiolani Park

Title: Town culture and Ala Moana
Walk_Bus: Recovery day after Diamond Head. TheBus 2 / 13 / 42 toward downtown / Chinatown. Maunakea Marketplace snacks. Walk civic core and Kawaiaha'o exterior. Optional paid Iolani Palace interior only if you want tickets. Afternoon swim Ala Moana Beach Park or Fort DeRussy (calmer). Sunset at Magic Island — bus 42 / E / W; on the sand by 5:30 PM.
Rideshare: Not needed for town; short hops only.
Places: Maunakea Marketplace; Kawaiaha'o Church; Iolani Palace; Ala Moana Beach Park; Magic Island; Fort DeRussy Beach Park

Title: Koko Head Crater Stairs
Walk_Bus: Hard hike after a rest day. 2 / 2L to Kahala Mall, transfer to 23 toward Hawaii Kai (or 1L). Get off near Lunalilo Home Rd and Anapalau; walk into Koko Head District Park. Lots of water, sun, trail shoes. Cool-down at Sandy Beach on 23. Return 23 → Kahala → 2 / 2L. Check DaBus2 that morning. If island-wide storm: swap to town or Waikiki shoreline (no exposed stairs).
Rideshare: About $40 to $60 round trip if legs are shot after the stairs.
Car_Backup: Park in the district park lot if you rent a car later.
Places: Koko Head District Park; Koko Crater Stairs; Sandy Beach

Title: Near-hotel nature and sunset
Walk_Bus: Easy recovery near Malia — do not miss free Waikiki. Morning: Ala Wai Canal walk and/or Fort DeRussy swim. Midday: Kuhio / Queen's Surf beach time or Kapahulu snacks. Optional short hop to Ala Moana Beach Park. Evening: Magic Island or Kapiolani sunset by 5:30 PM. Check Hilton fireworks schedule week-of (free from the sand). Rain day backup for harder hikes.
Rideshare: Short Uber only if tired — most of this is walkable.
Places: Waikiki Beach; Queen's Surf Beach; Fort DeRussy Beach Park; Ala Wai Canal; Magic Island; Kapiolani Park

Title: Makapu'u and east lookouts
Walk_Bus: 2 / 2L to Kahala, transfer to 23 toward Makapu'u / Sea Life Park. Paved lighthouse trail (~2 mi RT). Winter mornings good for shore whales. Add Halona Blowhole and Ka'iwi shoreline on the same corridor. Alternate if energy/weather: Kuliouou Ridge (free ridge; muddy if raining) — same east buses. Aim back before dark (sunset ~5:49).
Rideshare: About $40 to $70 round trip for an early start.
Car_Backup: Early car helps if buses are sparse at dawn.
Places: Makapu'u Lighthouse Trail; Makapu'u Lookout; Halona Blowhole Lookout; Ka'iwi Shoreline; Kuliouou Ridge Trailhead

Title: North Shore nature day
Walk_Bus: Long bus day on fresher legs. 42 / E / W to Ala Moana, then 60 along windward/North Shore (Waimea Bay shore walks) and/or 52 to Haleiwa. Dec = big-wave season — Pipeline / Sunset Beach viewing from shore (do not swim big winter surf). Optional self-pay Waimea Valley garden. Local shrimp or poke in Haleiwa. Allow 2 to 3 hours each way; start early. If Kona storm: swap to east lookouts or town.
Rideshare: About $90 or more each way — only if the bus day runs long.
Car_Backup: Good car day for beach hopping without schedules.
Places: Waimea Bay; Haleiwa Town; Banzai Pipeline; Sunset Beach; Waimea Valley; Giovanni's Shrimp Truck

Title: Manoa Falls and Lyon Arboretum
Walk_Bus: TheBus 13 (or 6 via UH / Manoa) to Manoa Falls; rainforest trail. Add Lyon Arboretum if open. Muddy after rain — grippy shoes. Rain rule: if steady valley rain or flash-flood risk, swap this day with Dec 2 town day or do east paved lookouts instead. Return Kapahulu for Ono Seafood or Leonard's.
Car_Backup: Park near trailhead / arboretum if driving.
Places: Manoa Falls Trailhead; Lyon Arboretum; Ono Seafood; Leonard's Bakery

Title: Lanikai Pillbox and Ulupo Heiau
Walk_Bus: 42 / E / W to Ala Moana, transfer to 67 toward Kailua; 671 for Kailua Beach / Lanikai. Early Pillbox hike (short, steep). Swim Kailua Beach. Walk or short bus to Ulupo Heiau by Kawainui — free cultural site. Prefer this on a clear windward morning; if windward socked in, swap with a leeward / east day.
Rideshare: About $50 to $80 if you rideshare Pillbox or Ulupo links.
Car_Backup: Early car helps for Pillbox parking limits.
Places: Lanikai Pillbox Trail; Kailua Beach Park; Ulupo Heiau; Kalapawai Cafe

Title: Ho'omaluhia and Pali
Walk_Bus: 42 / E / W to Ala Moana, then 60 to Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden (free; water + bug spray). Kawainui marsh paths if energy allows. Nuuanu Pali Lookout — short rideshare simplest from windward. Optional small-fee Byodo-In on 65. Lighter than stairs; good after Pillbox. No windward circle tour.
Rideshare: About $40 to $80 for Pali / Byodo-In links.
Car_Backup: Car loops Ho'omaluhia, Kawainui, and Pali easily.
Places: Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden; Kawainui Marsh; Nuuanu Pali Lookout; Byodo-In Temple

Title: Departure day
Walk_Bus: Uber for Pu'u Ualaka'a (Tantalus) sunrise (~6:58 AM). Check out by noon; store bags. Optional Bishop Museum (TheBus 2 only if bags stored). Punchbowl then Uber to HNL with luggage for 10:55 PM flight — do not bus with bags. Allow airport buffer.
Rideshare: Uber for Tantalus, Punchbowl, and the airport.
Car_Backup: Return any rental at the airport or Waikiki.
Places: Pu'u Ualaka'a State Park; Bishop Museum; National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific; Honolulu International Airport
